kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Middle Persian [script needed] (hlylk' /⁠halīlag⁠/, “myrobalan”), from Sanskrit हरीतकी (harītakī), ultimately from a Dravidian source; compare Telugu కరక (karaka).
g: black myrobalan (fruit and tree of Terminalia chebula)
myrobalan in general (fruit and tree of Terminalia gen. sive sp. qualibet)
